"""Main records closed pristine update and cache-setting comparisons."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import time

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
D = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/docs-sycl-storage-retention-20261009')
W = D.parent / 'sync-xe-v0143-nonfinite-20261012'
F = D / 'bench/results/2026-10-12-latest-updates-pristine-builds-host-regression'
R = B / 'research-20261009'
L = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('update_final_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV = dict(PATH=str(L / 'venv/bin') + ':' + str(L / 'bin') + ':/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8')
ENV['GEM_PATH'] = str(L / 'distro/usr/share/rubygems-integration/all') + ':/usr/share/rubygems-integration/all:/usr/lib/ruby/gems/3.2.0'
ENV['RUBYLIB'] = ':'.join([str(L / 'distro/usr/lib/ruby/vendor_ruby')] + [str(p) for p in sorted((L / 'distro/usr/share/rubygems-integration/all/gems').glob('*/lib'))])


def identity(p):
    return dict(path=str(p), sha256=m.sha(p), bytes=p.stat().st_size)


def compact(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        result = {}
        for key, item in value.items():
            if any(word in key.lower() for word in ('token', 'api')) and isinstance(item, str) and len(item) == 64 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in item):
                result[key] = dict(sha256=item)
            else:
                result[key] = compact(item)
        return result
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [compact(item) for item in value]
    if isinstance(value, str) and len(value.encode()) > 32768:
        return dict(bytes=len(value.encode()), sha256=hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest(),
                    head=value[:8192], tail=value[-4096:], scope='Compact derivative; original identity is recorded')
    return value


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'latest-update-main-updates-final-boundary-root-v3'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, commands=[], artifacts=[],
             source=identity(Path(__file__)), gpu_executed=False)
    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    staged = out / 'staged'
    staged.mkdir()
    prepared = []
    start = time.monotonic()

    def write(relative, value):
        p = staged / relative
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        raw = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n'
        assert len(raw.encode()) < 1 << 20, (relative, len(raw.encode()))
        p.write_text(raw)
        prepared.append((p, F / relative))

    def run(label, argv, cwd=D):
        left = 600 - (time.monotonic() - start)
        assert left > 0
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, cwd, wall=min(120, left), cpu=480,
            rss_cap=8 << 30, text_cap=64 << 20, file_cap=64 << 20, total_cap=96 << 20)
        r.setdefault('evidence', {})[label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label
        return so.read_text().strip()

    def archive(p):
        value = json.loads(p.read_text())
        assert value['complete'] and value['passed'] and not value['active'], str(p)
        for c in value.get('commands', []) + value.get('guard_commands', []):
            assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['ownership_status'] == 'observed'
            assert c['exit_code'] == 0 and not c['cleanup'] and not c['survivors'] and not c.get('errors')
        derivative = dict(value)
        if 'owned_progress' in derivative:
            seq = derivative.pop('owned_progress')
            derivative['owned_progress_summary'] = dict(count=len(seq), first=seq[:1], last=seq[-1:])
        write('receipts-v160/' + str(p.relative_to(B)).replace('/', '--'),
            dict(original=identity(p), derivative=True, original_status_preserved=True, receipt=compact(derivative)))
        return value

    def model_review(p):
        v = archive(p)
        assert v['model_normal_close'] and v['boot_unchanged'] and v['kernel_gate_passed']
        assert not v.get('error') and not v.get('primary_model_failure')
        assert v['request_done_seen'] and v['gen_send_attempted']
        assert v['model_close']['normal'] and not v['model_close']['forced']
        assert v['model_close']['quit_exit_outcome'] == 'exit observed'
        for key, item in v.items():
            if key.startswith('kernel-') and isinstance(item, dict):
                assert not item.get('fault_entries') and not item.get('dump_present')
        for key in ('startup_diagnostics', 'startup_protocol_diagnostics', 'post_ready_diagnostics',
                    'final_diagnostics', 'protocol_diagnostics'):
            assert not v[key]['severe_messages']
        val = v['validation']
        assert val['prompt_tokens'] == 32768 and val['generated_tokens'] == 16
        assert val['finish'] == 'length' and len(val['output_ids']) == 16 and len(val['token_logprob_lines']) == 32
        assert val['engine_prefill_ms'] > 0 and val['engine_decode_ms'] > 0
        return v

    try:
        assert not run('status-before', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        assert run('branch', ['/usr/bin/git', 'branch', '--show-current']) == 'docs/sycl-storage-retention-2026-10-09'
        assert run('origin', ['/usr/bin/git', 'remote', 'get-url', 'origin']) == 'git@github.com:yqYo1/Strata.git'
        assert all(line.startswith('file:/home/yayoi/.config/git/config') for line in
            run('identity', ['/usr/bin/git', 'config', '--show-origin', '--get-regexp', r'^user\.(name|email)$']).splitlines())
        remote = {}
        for label, url, expected in (('official', 'https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata.git',
                '7695859aa13afb248bdb4d36f9b2e95707db079d'),
                ('xestrata', 'https://github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata.git',
                'da3d426079019daa6e01388d03b0d94ae67070b7')):
            text = run('remote-' + label, ['/usr/bin/git', 'ls-remote', url, 'HEAD'])
            assert len(text.splitlines()) == 1 and text.split()[1] == 'HEAD'
            remote[label] = dict(url=url, head=text.split()[0], measured_revision=expected,
                                 unchanged=text.split()[0] == expected)
        old_p = B / 'latest-update-pristine-official-long-model-root-v1/official-model/record.json'
        new_p = B / 'latest-update-pristine-official-cache512-model-root-v1/official-model/record.json'
        old, new = model_review(old_p), model_review(new_p)
        assert new['effective_info']['expert_slots'] == '624'
        assert new['validation']['actual_route'] == old['validation']['actual_route'] == 'serial_read_windows8'
        assert new['input']['sha256'] == old['input']['sha256']
        assert new['binary'] == old['binary'] and new['environment'] == old['environment']
        assert new['boot_id'] == old['boot_id']
        old_argv, new_argv = list(old['argv']), list(new['argv'])
        assert old_argv[old_argv.index('--expert-cache') + 1] == '128'
        assert new_argv[new_argv.index('--expert-cache') + 1] == '512'
        new_argv[new_argv.index('--expert-cache') + 1] = '128'
        assert old_argv == new_argv
        assert new['model_inputs'] == old['model_inputs']
        for snapshot in new['mapping_snapshots'].values():
            assert len(snapshot['files']) == 30
            assert all(m.sha(Path(path)) == item['sha256'] for path, item in snapshot['files'].items())
        for name in ('latest-update-main-provider-health-official-model-root-v10',
                     'latest-update-main-cache512-model-health-root-v1'):
            archive(B / name / 'record.json')
        review = B / 'latest-update-main-cache512-startup-review-v1.json'
        assert json.loads(review.read_text())['passed']
        write('official-cache512-main-startup-review-v160.json',
              dict(original=identity(review), receipt=compact(json.loads(review.read_text()))))
        samples = []
        for label, v, p in (('cache128', old, old_p), ('cache512', new, new_p)):
            q = v['validation']
            samples.append(dict(setting=label, receipt=identity(p),
                expert_slots=int(v['effective_info']['expert_slots']), argv=v['argv'], environment=v['environment'],
                input=compact(v['input']), validation=compact(q), host_wall_samples=v['host_wall_samples'],
                prefill_tokens_per_second=32768000 / q['engine_prefill_ms'],
                decode_tokens_per_second=16000 / q['engine_decode_ms'], performance_eligible=False))
        write('official-cache128-cache512-results-v160.json', dict(main_reviewed=True,
            source_revision='7695859aa13afb248bdb4d36f9b2e95707db079d', binary=new['binary'],
            individual_samples=samples, same_argv_except_cache=True, same_environment_input_binary_boot=True,
            generated_ids_equal=old['validation']['output_ids'] == new['validation']['output_ids'],
            reported_lp5_equal=old['validation']['token_logprob_sha256'] == new['validation']['token_logprob_sha256'],
            normal_owned_quit_and_fault_checks_passed=True,
            scope='One diagnostic sample per setting, with validation/progress logging; not optimal or clean performance.',
            decision='No default changed. Output IDs and reported LP5 differ after cache placement changes CPU/GPU routes. No task-quality equivalence is established. Prefill and decode must be assessed separately in any clean repeated comparison.',
            optimized_upstream_settings_qualified=False, full262144_runtime_qualified=False,
            remote_heads_rechecked=remote,
            next='Official auto/worker3 are distinct pending candidates. Large-batch host-marker path remains excluded by unsupported native host/shared USM atomics.'))
        reports = []
        for number in range(247, 259):
            found = [B / 'research-native-free-gpu-kernel-roofline-eligibility-round252-v1.txt'] if number == 252 else list(R.glob('*round' + str(number) + '-v1.txt'))
            assert len(found) == 1 and found[0].is_file(), number
            reports += found
        reports.append(R / 'implementation-prefill-cpu-job-histogram-source-v1.txt')
        entries = []
        for p in reports:
            relative = 'research/' + p.name
            dest = staged / relative
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            dest.write_text(p.read_text().rstrip('\n') + '\n')
            prepared.append((dest, F / relative))
            entries.append(dict(original=identity(p), archive=relative, archive_identity=identity(dest),
                normalization='Only repeated EOF newlines normalized; original unchanged',
                model='gpt-6.1-sol' if p.name.startswith('implementation-') else 'gpt-6-luna',
                main_full_report_review=True, status='completed', measured=False))
        previous = F / 'report-registry-v158.json'
        assert json.loads(previous.read_text())['research_completed'] == 748
        write('report-registry-v160.json', dict(research_completed=748 + len(entries),
            prior_registry_path=str(previous.relative_to(D)), prior_registry_sha256=m.sha(previous),
            new_reports=entries, main_sole_execution_owner=True,
            corrections=[
                'R248/R250 short historical R244/R245 labels differ from current reports; resolve by full paths/hashes.',
                'R249 establishes that official DONE traffic is decode-only and some --stats values are process lifetime.',
                'R251 eligibility depends on actual per-layer types and exact MMQ/FUSED settings. Real pack has IQ3_S GU/IQ4_NL Down and other mixed pairs; no all-IQ3_S assumption, Dm16 quality or arena saving is accepted.',
                'R254 quotes generic source. Actual official compiled prompt/cache source is sycl/src/program/generate.cpp. Main already measured128 and fixes adapt-swaps0: suggested duplicate screens are dropped. Its description of R249 as a layer-major byte model is incorrect; R249 audits request counters.',
                'Sol histogram and Main raw CPU samples remain SourceOnlyUnverified. R255 approves attribution only, not execution; complete-status/invalid/overflow gates are required. R256 exact grouped JIT probe would prove compile admission, not kernel execution.'],
            recurring_research_next='R257/R258 reviewed; next scopes concern completed source contracts and existing optimized-upstream parameter evidence' ))
        failed_p = B / 'latest-update-main-updates-final-boundary-root-v1/record.json'
        failed = json.loads(failed_p.read_text())
        assert not failed['active'] and not failed['passed'] and failed['error'] == "AssertionError('report-lints')"
        write('publisher-lint-environment-failure-v160.json', dict(original=identity(failed_p), original_status_preserved=True, receipt=compact(failed), cause='Ruby GEM_PATH/RUBYLIB and Python venv tools were absent from allowlisted publisher1 environment; publisher2 uses installed tool paths. No source/GPU result changed.'))
        for extra_name in ('latest-update-main-updates-final-boundary-root-v2/record.json', 'latest-update-main-publisher-license-diagnosis-root-v1/record.json', 'latest-update-main-unpublished-v160-rollback-v1.json'):
            extra_p = B / extra_name
            extra_v = json.loads(extra_p.read_text())
            assert not extra_v['active']
            write('publication-diagnostics-v160/' + extra_name.replace('/', '--'), dict(original=identity(extra_p), original_status_preserved=True, receipt=compact(extra_v), scope='Optional whole-tree REUSE on old report-storage branch fails for missing pre-existing license metadata, including historical runtime headers; actual updated source WN REUSE and report-specific Markdown/JSON/codespell/secret checks pass. No model/source test changed.'))
        sources = [Path(__file__), B / 'latest-update-main-updates-final-boundary-v1.py', B / 'latest-update-main-updates-final-boundary-v2.py', B / 'latest-update-main-cache512-phase-v1.py']
        for folder in ('implementation-prefill-cpu-job-histogram-source-v1', 'implementation-iq-avx2-raw-samples-source-v1'):
            root = B / folder
            sources += [p for p in sorted(root.iterdir()) if p.is_file()]
        index = []
        for i, p in enumerate(sources):
            relative = 'source-packets-v160/' + str(i).zfill(3) + '-' + p.name + '.json'
            write(relative, dict(identity=identity(p), content=p.read_text(), scope='Source-only archive is not qualification'))
            index.append(dict(original=identity(p), archive=relative))
        write('source-packets-v160.json', dict(files=index, all_experiment_patches_unapplied=True,
            next_consumer='Main reviews and qualifies in isolated worktree after update campaign'))
        integration = json.loads((F / 'integrated-full32k-clean-results-v158.json').read_text())
        xe = json.loads((B / 'latest-update-pristine-configured-model-root-v1/xe-model/record.json').read_text())
        assert xe['passed'] and not xe['active']
        guard = integration['statistics']['on']
        md = f'''<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# Latest upstream and XeStrata updates on Arc B570

Official v0.1.43 `7695859` and XeStrata xe0.1.42 `da3d426` were built and measured without
local engine patches. Required upstream functionality was imported and pushed on
`sync/xe-v0143-nonfinite-20261012` at `0691bcdf`. This is selective integration into the
existing fork; its engine version remains xe0.1.40.2.2. The original workspace branch remains unchanged.

All rows use native Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_S, 32,768 input IDs and16 generated IDs on
Ryzen5600X / Arc B57010GiB. Compiler, runtime and prompt routes differ: this is not a
controlled implementation speed ranking. Exact commands, environment, individual samples,
fingerprints, source/runtime/binary and normal-close/fault receipts are in the JSON results.

| Source / setting | Prompt route | Prefill t/s | Decode t/s | Scope |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Pristine XeStrata xe0.1.42 | Batched8192 | {32768000 / xe['validation']['engine_prefill_ms']:.2f} | {16000 / xe['validation']['engine_decode_ms']:.2f} | One diagnostic; LLVM7.1.1 free;29/144 slots filled |
| Pristine official cache128 | Serial windows8 | {samples[0]['prefill_tokens_per_second']:.2f} | {samples[0]['decode_tokens_per_second']:.2f} | One diagnostic; icpx2026.1;144 slots |
| Pristine official cache512 | Serial windows8 | {samples[1]['prefill_tokens_per_second']:.2f} | {samples[1]['decode_tokens_per_second']:.2f} | One diagnostic; icpx2026.1;624 slots |
| Selectively integrated update | Batched8192 | {guard['prefill_tokens_per_second']['mean']:.2f} | {guard['decode_tokens_per_second']['mean']:.2f} | Three clean samples; LLVM7.1.1 free; nonfinite detection on |

Required imports include server memory admission/session SAVE, context overflow, reasoning/
launcher/setup fixes, cache opt-out and logit-bias validation. Unsupported native logit bias
returns400. The server suite has516 pass/11 skip; focused helpers, free/contrib-LLVM CPU,
host sanitizer and small real GPU integer/nonfinite checks also passed. Actual32K runs
closed normally with fresh health and no observed GPU fault. Nonfinite detection stays:
three decode pairs did not establish a reproducible benefit from removing it. The whole
37,462-ID held-out input matched both detection arms'16 IDs and reported LP5.

Cache512 was slower in prompt and faster in decode in its single diagnostic sample.
Its output IDs and reported LP5 differ from cache128, consistent with changed CPU/GPU
placement but not a task-quality parity proof. No cache default or inference implementation
was selected from that screen. Best-tuned upstream parameters, full262,144-token physical
context, RESTORE, full-vocabulary logits and task-quality parity remain unqualified.
No CUDA/HIP change was selected. Read-only research continues; histogram/raw-sample
proposals are unapplied source packets. See registryv160 for reviewed research and corrections.
'''
        p = staged / 'UPDATE_RESULTS-v160.md'
        p.write_text(md)
        prepared.append((p, F / p.name))
        leak = out / 'secret-scan.json'
        run('private-secret-scan', [str(L / 'bin/gitleaks'), 'dir', str(staged), '--no-banner', '--redact',
                                  '--report-format', 'json', '--report-path', str(leak)])
        assert json.loads(leak.read_text()) == []
        run('report-lints', ['/bin/bash', str(W / 'tools/lint/run.sh'), *[str(p) for p, _ in prepared if p.suffix in ('.json', '.md')]], cwd=W)
        for p, target in prepared:
            assert not target.exists()
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(p.read_bytes())
            r['artifacts'].append(identity(target))
        run('whole-secret-scan', [str(L / 'bin/gitleaks'), 'dir', str(F), '--no-banner', '--redact'])
        run('stage', ['/usr/bin/git', 'add', '--', *[str(p.relative_to(D)) for _, p in prepared]])
        run('check', ['/usr/bin/git', 'diff', '--cached', '--check'])
        run('commit', ['/usr/bin/git', 'commit', '-m', 'docs(sycl): compare pristine updates and official cache settings'])
        r['revision'] = run('head', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push', ['/usr/bin/git', 'push', 'origin', 'HEAD'])
        assert not run('status-after', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain'])
        r['complete'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        import traceback
        r['error'] = repr(error)
        r['traceback'] = traceback.format_exc()
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'error', 'revision')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
